title: Signal: Service account token auto-mounted via automountServiceAccountToken: true (k8s) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the pod or service account manifest.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches the explicit true; an absent field inherits the namespace default and is not flagged.
fpNotes: Controllers that genuinely call the API server need a token and are the accepted case when scoped.
